subject: general
question: Which of the following is not a web browser?
solution:
**The correct answer is 'Fedora'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **Fedora:**

 
 
• Fedora is not a web browser; it is a **Linux-based operating system** that provides a secure and open-source platform for users. It is developed by the **Fedora Project and sponsored by Red Hat**.
 
• It is designed to be user-friendly
